Now that cursed man conceived rancor in his heart against the bishop,
and the next day he ordered one of the soldiers to be killed.
And the bishop ran to him to make entreaty,
and he found him riding between the two walls.
And when the cursed man saw the bishop,
he was enraged, and reviled him, and struck him with the spear that was in his hand, and killed him.
And after two days the believers were able to take him,
and they escorted him and buried him in the Great Church.
And when the Sultan heard of the coming of the Franks,
he left and went away.
And in the year 489 [written in letters],
489 of the Arabs [in figures],
which is the year
1407 [in letters],
1407 of the Greeks [in figures],
astrologers decreed
that a deluge, like that which happened in the days of Noah, was about to happen.
And the Caliph al-Mustazhir summoned Ibn 'Isun the astronomer,
and asked him about this.
And he said to him:
"In the days of Noah, all seven wandering stars gathered together in the constellation of Pisces,
and that great deluge took place.
And in this year,
Cronus (Saturn) alone is not in Pisces.
And if it had been joined with them,
perhaps there would have been a deluge like that one.
Yes, I say
that in some place a great multitude of people from many lands will be gathered,
and they will all perish by water."
And after some days news arrived
that upon those who were going to worship in Mecca,
a flood came upon them,
and drowned all of them.
And in this year,
while Gabriel the Greek was ruler in Melitene, he killed with deadly poison a man named Abu Salim, an Orthodox chieftain,
the son-in-law of the sons of Abu 'Imran.
And after a year that cursed man killed the faithful and God-fearing merchants:
Barṣawma son of the nun, and his two sons,
and Basil of Ḥawa,
and the deacon Sahda of Tiantini {OCR?}.
And he took from their houses and from that of Abu Manṣur bar Malka gold, silver, and goods,
and from the church of the bishop crosses, censers, the flagon of myron, and all its treasure,
and he destroyed their houses. And in this year, which is the year {OCR?}
and he built the fortress and the wall.
